notes: Reached perigold.com DIRECTLY with curl_cffi impersonate=chrome (desktop Chrome TLS profile), exactly as the prior Home-Decor pass; no proxy needed and no PerimeterX challenge on any of the ~120 fetches. Category tree came from three cross-checked sources: (a) the unprotected sitemaps seo-category-sitemap~0.xml (84 department/cat URLs) and seo-sb0-sitemap~0.xml (376 leaf-category URLs); (b) the mega-nav embedded in every page's server-rendered HTML; and (c) the Shop by Category cards rendered on each /cat/ department page. The cards are the fullest source - the mega-nav is a curated subset (Storage Furniture shows 2 children in the nav but 12 cards on its own page, and Custom Upholstery does not appear in the sitemap at all). Furniture lives in three departments: Furniture (10 children - Living Room, Custom Upholstery, Bedroom, Home Office, Kitchen & Dining Room, Bar, Storage, Entryway & Hallway, Game Room, plus a cross-link into Baby & Kids), Outdoor (Outdoor Lounge Furniture, Outdoor Dining & Bar Furniture) and Bath (Bathroom Vanities, Medicine Cabinets, Bathroom Shelves & Storage). Kitchen and Dining & Entertaining were opened and contain no furniture (no kitchen-island node exists). QTY SOURCE: every leaf is an /sb0/ browse page whose rendered listing header reads 'N Items'. That literal header string was captured from the served HTML for all 84 leaves and matched the RSC payload resultCount on 84/84, so the header - not a structured-data guess - is what is recorded. VERIFICATION: (1) exhaustion at 48 items/page - Jewelry Armoires 8 -> page 2 empty; Kids Desks 2 -> page 2 empty; Storage Ottomans 56 -> page 1 = 48 tiles, page 2 = 10 tiles (2 of which are sponsored injections), page 3 empty, i.e. ceil(56/48) = 2 populated pages as expected. (2) Discrimination check - the Shop All total differs for every department (26,690 / 2,290 / 6,158 / 1,568 / 5,223 / 10,227 / 1,911 / 90 / 1,140 / 9,551 / 6,165 / 230), so it is not a site-wide constant. (3) Game Room Furniture Shop All = 90 = Pool Tables 63 + Shuffleboards 27 exactly. (4) The h1 of every page fetched was compared against the category expected. HIERARCHY: /cat/ nodes are departments and never carry a listing resultCount, so all of them are emitted as grouping rows and only /sb0/ leaves carry qty. The one exception is Entryway & Hallway Furniture, which exposes no child categories at all, so it is emitted as a leaf using its own rendered Shop All header (1,568 Items) and flagged because its products are cross-listed under other nodes. No /sb0/ node has child categories of its own (the TopBlocks-CategoryNavigation block was checked on all 84 leaf pages), so this is the deepest valid level; anything deeper on Perigold is an /sb1/ filter recut. DEDUPLICATION: Bookcases & Etageres, Armoires, Sideboards & Buffets and Filing Cabinets each appear under two parents, and Outdoor Accent Stools appears under both outdoor parents; each is emitted exactly once, under its primary parent. EXCLUDED: style/material recuts of Desks (Traditional, Modern, Wood, Sustainably Sourced) as filter pages; Mattresses, crib & bassinet mattresses, mattress foundations and all bedding; Wall Shelves, Decorative Baskets & Bins, Decorative Boxes, Magazine Racks, Jewelry Boxes, Desktop Organizers, Toy Boxes & Organizers and Hampers & Baskets as standalone storage goods; Outdoor Furniture Covers and Outdoor Furniture Cushions as parts/textiles; Patio Umbrellas, Planters, Outdoor Fireplaces, Fountains, Garden Statues, Bird Baths and all grills / pizza ovens; all lighting, mirrors, rugs, textiles, wall art, tableware, kitchen appliances and bathroom fixtures (sinks, toilets, tubs, faucets, tiles, towel bars, grab bars); Play Kitchen Sets and Nap Mats as toys/textiles; changing-table toppers and pads; and every Sale / New Arrivals / Bestselling / brand / designer-shop link. DEAD NODE: /furniture/sb0/arcade-games-slot-machine-c1875043.html 302-redirects to the Game Room Furniture department page (caught by the h1 check) and carries no count of its own, so it was dropped rather than given the parent's number.
